metadata.chemistry_rationale: Sensitivity hypothesis for an analogous dimethoxy substituent structure: a separate methoxy-carbon envelope is tested in addition to the common PDI C 1s assignments and pi-pi* satellite.
metadata.position_basis: Broad uncalibrated methoxy-carbon bounds are literature-informed but intentionally overlap the C-N/C-Cl envelope. Acceptance requires a stable, resolved component with defensible area and low parameter correlation after the sample-wide C 1s calibration.
metadata.structure_assumption: Two methoxy-carbon atoms are assumed only for this sensitivity test; confirm the exact PDI-OMe-COOH structure before scientific acceptance.
